title: Proposal for Chinese Dialects as Electives for Primary and Secondary School Students
what_it_is: Proposal for Chinese Dialects as Electives for Primary and Secondary School Students

sections.label: No dialect elective in schools
sections.summary: Schools focus on English and Mother Tongue Languages, with no plans to introduce Chinese dialects as an elective; interested students can explore clan association classes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Our focus remains on developing students' proficiency in English and their Mother Tongue Languages.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: There are currently no plans to introduce Chinese dialects as an elective in our schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Students who are interested in learning dialects can explore classes organised by the Chinese clan associations.

sections.label: Dialects as cultural heritage elective
sections.summary: Dialects are part of Singapore Chinese culture and heritage; the Government maintains its language policy while students can learn dialects via clan associations or online resources.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: So, in that spirit, just as how we, perhaps, have certain economic incentives to learn certain foreign languages, could we also not have pilots where it need not be an examinable subject, but it could be one where we can have it as an elective to better promote the understanding of a crucial part of our cultural identity?

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We recognise that Chinese dialects are part of the Singapore Chinese culture and heritage, and we welcome the clans' efforts to do so, even as the Government maintains our existing language policy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Our focus continues to be on building up competency and proficiency in English language as well as the Mother Tongue Languages.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Our students, who are curious and interested in learning Chinese dialects, apart from approaching the Chinese clan associations, can also go online.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: There is a huge repertoire of resources that are available for self-directed learning.
